items.title: Upscale, your way
items.text: Anime and films each with levels C, B and A, A the strongest, and a button in the player to change it as you watch. Settings › Picture and sound.

items.title: See in the dark
items.text: Dark scenes clearer in a bright room, and Brightness for a brighter screen while you watch. Settings › Picture and sound.

items.title: Clear voice
items.text: Speech clearer through the TV's own dialogue enhancer, stereo and Atmos as they are. Even volume too.

items.title: Accounts
items.text: Keep several Stremio accounts on this TV and switch in one press. Settings › Accounts.

items.title: Only the words
items.text: Sound descriptions like [coughs] and (gunshots) hidden, and subtitles lined up sooner and more smoothly.

items.title: Recent searches
items.text: Kept on this TV only, saved as you search, with Clear history.
